summary:
Dealsuite.com is M&A platform for Dealmakers. Exclusive Proprietary deals + Relevant Dealflow. 
Dealmakers can't afford to miss out.  , founded in 2017. Type: startup / scale-up. About 45 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Dealsuite is a small Amsterdam software platform matching M&A advisors and investors, staffed largely by business grads, but not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: Dealsuite runs an online platform where M&A advisors, investment firms and corporate buyers swap buy- and sell-side deals, matched by an AI algorithm.
It is a small team of about 45 people on LinkedIn, based in Amsterdam, mostly in sales, business development and customer success.
Staff often studied international business or economics at the University of Amsterdam, VU Amsterdam or Erasmus University Rotterdam.

open.text: Dealsuite is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, an entry-level sales role in Amsterdam, needs no Dutch and shows the pay.

growth.text: Founded in 2017, it says it has grown fast and now has active members in more than 50 countries.
